prompt: One clear instructional illustration asset for a preschool mobile gravity game: show how to hold a phone FLAT, screen facing UP toward the ceiling, like holding a little tray. Original flat 2D vector-like bright child-friendly art, cream mint sky blue and warm yellow, thick simple rounded outlines, minimal shadows, no realism, no text, NO letters or digits, NO interface buttons. Wide 3:2 composition on a transparent background. Screen is a pale mint rectangle with a tiny silver-blue marble and one yellow star suggesting a tilt maze. A simple horizontal mint dotted reference line below the phone and a large green checkmark beside it make flat orientation obvious. Add one very small inset at top-right showing a VERTICAL upright phone with a coral cross, clearly secondary. Avoid showing a phone tilted steeply toward the viewer, avoid landscape-vs-portrait confusion: the important concept is SCREEN FACING UP / tray horizontal, not changing screen rotation. No arrows suggesting spinning, no detailed skin texture, no famous characters. Generous clean empty margins for app overlay heading drawn in code. Crisp readable silhouettes for children age5-6.
